scope: Substantive external-foundations atlas and full-lifecycle design proposal; targeted static code reads and primary-source research. No product changes, runtime verification, code acceptance or finding closure.
architecture_boundary: Existing ratified SDD/CTM/identity boundaries are inputs; no system-design-decisions changes in this wave. Shared semantic obligations do not create a universal persisted envelope, new status lattice or sovereign GroundService.
delegation: One level. Root sole tracked writer; researchers/reviewers restricted to assigned ignored notes. No children, product execution, installations, environments or production payload access.
root_review: Read all eight research notes, five new grounds and seven source cards, and both independent reviews. Independently read decisive pinned CAS/catalog/claim/access/audit/control-store/academic/cursor paths and primary COPE, Crossref, DataCite, NISO abstract, ILO, PREMIS, LOC, FORCE11, W3C PROF/DCAT/PROV and RFC passages. Not a whole-repository census or full literature review.
review_corrections: Capture terminality, coherent snapshot and selected-scope coverage are separate; mutable-offset counterexample retained.
Publication fence includes known source-generation writer and commit linearization, not a final check followed by an unfenced write. No external-world freeze or unseen-event knowledge is promised.
Both used basis and source change reach public conclusion via the canonical claim owner; verifier appointments require exact predicate/purpose and non-producer provenance.
Same-tenant reuse resolves applicable case/purpose/recipient/field grant and permit generation across source, cache, index, derivative and projection.

Retention is conditional; all controlled copies including audit/WORM/provider derivatives require outcome accounting. Historical heads survive only in permitted form; full replay cannot be promised after material loss.
Logical request identity is distinct from receipt hash; opaque cursor hashes are not assumed harmless diagnostics.

Static CAS/member verification is not multi-object release atomicity or cheap random access. Job/progress/event/outbox SQL transaction already exists in pinned source; older prose describing another source is not carried forward.
Batch cursor promotion is intentionally fail-closed/no-op in inspected code; README does not override source. Generic refresh/outbox composition absence is not claimed repository-wide.
Free growth separates configuration, adapters and semantic engines. New authority or unknown facet cannot be installed by data; algorithm memory is distinct from ingest streaming.

ILO matrix-aging statement scoped to one-to-many estimates; DCAT truth/authority limitation explicitly PolicyOS inference. COPE partial-retraction caution retained while actual Crossref event types remain ingestible.
Fixity with a new baseline can support future comparisons, not reconstruct missing historical provenance. Source path abbreviations expanded and an incorrect run_lifecycle path corrected.
independent_review_result: No confirmed design blocker or new finding class in the bounded final package. F1/F2/LDR-01/LDR-02 closed at proposal level; all-copy erasure and composed runtime verification remain implementation limitations, not PASS.

checks.scope: Documentation-only stdlib/read-only Git checks; no product execution

preassembly_check.result: Expected missing-link failure before research-receipt-r5.json was authored; other documentary checks passed. Retained separately.

remaining_limits: Observed mechanisms and gaps refer only to named paths at pinned code snapshot. Runtime branch may advance; implementation needs delta review and affected-consumer census.
The atlas records are editorial knowledge, not admitted task evidence, institution competence, rights or legal advice. Real task inputs/permissions/notices require acquisition and validation.
No external payload snapshots or content digests retained; URLs/source cards do not prove immutable evidence custody. NISO access is abstract/metadata only.
Future behavioral/removal/resource probes are not run. Neither full capture, recurring refresh, all-copy deletion nor source-to-public custody is claimed implemented by these documents.
Corpus and family counts enumerate local arrays, not knowledge coverage or independent evidence.
Ignored intermediate reports may contain superseded proposal language; final tracked synthesis and corrections above govern this research delivery.

resource_scope.note: Only light filesystem capacity check, small text files and targeted reads; coding task retains compute priority.
